subject: Nashville sponsorship: post-event numbers and invoice reconciliation
messages:
From: Kate Hughes <kate@technashcollective.org>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Nashville Tech Collective post-event report + invoice

Hi Sergio + team,

Thanks again for sponsoring Nashville Tech Collective last weekend — it was great to see Redwood represented. Attached is our post-event packet and the sponsor invoice (NTC_post_event_report.xlsx, sponsor-invoice.pdf). A few highlights from our side:

- Ticket scans -> opt-in matches: 42 distinct opt-ins (ticket ID -> email)
- HubSpot campaign (ntc-nashville-2026): 58 contacts created during event timeframe
- Lead quality: we flagged 8 partners/press contacts that were not eligible for sponsor credit

We noticed HubSpot is reporting more leads than our ticket mapping; sharing the report so you can reconcile. The invoice reflects the guaranteed exposure package and the agreed lead rebate terms — please confirm receipt and let us know who at Redwood will own validation.

Attachments:
- NTC_post_event_report.xlsx (event metrics, ticket -> email mapping)
- sponsor-invoice.pdf (invoice #NTC-2026-09)

Kate Hughes
Director, Partnerships
Nashville Tech Collective
kate@technashcollective.org

---
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kate Hughes <kate@technashcollective.org>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T11:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Nashville Tech Collective post-event report + invoice

Kate — thanks for the packet and the quick turnaround. We received both attachments. Ill own the sponsor reconciliation and will coordinate internal owners: Laura, can you run a CRM-to-ticket dedupe and produce a short reconciliation table? Marissa, can you look at the invoice vs contract (esp. the lead guarantee clause) and advise on payout timing.

Initial ask: could you also share the raw attendee CSV (email, ticket_id) if possible? That will speed matching on our side.

A few notes from my side on common mismatches we see:
- HubSpot campaign attribution sometimes captures SDR manual creates (post-demo follow-ups) that werent ticket-based opt-ins
- Attribution windows (first-touch vs last-touch vs multi-touch) will change the count depending on whats considered the qualifying interaction

Please leave the invoice as pending; well aim to get a reconciled position to you by EOD Oct 7.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

---
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-06T09:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Nashville Tech Collective post-event report + invoice

Folks — I pulled an export from HubSpot for campaign=ntc-nashville-2026 (created 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-04). Quick summary from the CRM side:

- Total contacts with campaign tag: 58
- Of those, 18 had existing company associations (likely not net-new for sponsor credit)
- Direct email matches to NTC ticket list: 12
- Contacts created by SDRs after demos (manual) and tagged: 16

Pipeline influence (at first-touch tagging): $54,000 across 5 opps. If we use last-touch only the credited pipeline drops to $31,000. The discrepancy with NTC's 42 opt-ins is likely because their ticket->opt-in mapping excludes corporate/press emails, and HubSpot picks up both ticket opt-ins + later manual creates.

Next steps I recommend:
1) We run a 1:1 dedupe between NTC raw attendee CSV and HubSpot contacts (email + ticket_id). Ill attach the export we used (recon_export.csv).
2) Mark in CRM which contacts are "sponsor-credited" (net-new, not corporate/press).
3) If contract requires net-new leads only, we should calculate sponsor credit from the deduped set.

If we do that, my preliminary net-new count looks closer to 42 (NTCs number), not 58 — which aligns with their report. Ill push the dedupe and share a clean list by EOD Oct 8.

Laura Bennett
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Nashville Tech Collective post-event report + invoice

Thanks, Laura. Contract check: Section 3.2 (Lead Guarantee) states sponsor is guaranteed credit for 50 "qualifying" net-new leads or a minimum exposure fee of $25,000; invoice currently requests $18,000 (line items: booth + branding) — see sponsor-invoice.pdf. I want to avoid setting a bad precedent on credits. Options:

A) If dedupe confirms 42 net-new leads -> propose we pay the invoice but provide a $6,000 marketing credit (to bring effective spend to $24k) toward a follow-up program
B) If dedupe supports 50 net-new leads -> process invoice in full, no credit required
C) Alternatively, pay full invoice now and agree a reconciled credit after the final dedupe (finance preferred if we can close reconciliation within 30 days)

Im leaning to option A to keep the partner relationship positive while protecting budget. Sergio, can you sign-off on A if Lauras final list lands at ~42? Also finance needs PO # and vendor remit details before processing (we can set up expedited payment week of Oct 12 with the PO).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---
From: Kate Hughes <kate@technashcollective.org>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-07T14:42:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Nashville Tech Collective post-event report + invoice

Sergio / Team — appreciate the rapid response and the proposed path. Im attaching the raw attendee export you requested (NTC_RawAttendees_20261002.csv) with ticket_id -> email -> opt-in flag.

Were happy to let Redwood do the dedupe and share the final net-new list. We can accept Option A (pay and apply marketing credit) if dedupe confirms ~42 net-new opt-ins. Please confirm the PO # youll use for payment; our finance team is prepared to accept a net-30, and the PO number is PO-NTC-9876.

Proposed timeline that works for us:
- Oct 8: Redwood shares deduped net-new list
- Oct 12: Redwood processes payment week (finance to issue payment)
- Oct 14: apply any agreed marketing credit to next campaign

Thanks — Kate
Kate Hughes
Director, Partnerships
Nashville Tech Collective
kate@technashcollective.org

Attachments: NTC_RawAttendees_20261002.csv (CSV mapping), NTC_post_event_report.xlsx, sponsor-invoice.pdf
